{{Quote|Me? I want nothing. I am only a runner. I work for the man who hired me.|translated=1|Unidentified Twi'lek messenger to Revan|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
This unidentified, green-skinned '''Twi'lek''' male was hired as a messenger for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Canderous Ordo]] during the latter's employment as [[Davik Kang]]'s enforcer on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KotOR" />

==Biography==
[[File:Lets_see_Canderous.png|thumb|left|280px|Revan, Carth Onasi, and Bastila Shan were asked to meet with Canderous Ordo.]]
In [[3956 BBY]], this individual attended that year's [[Tarisian Season Opener]], and witnessed [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] post the best time. Shortly after the culmination of the race, the messenger approached Revan and his companions in the [[South Apartments]] of the [[Upper City]], with a message from Canderous. Identifying him as the winner of the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race, the Twi'lek implored Revan to meet his employer in the [[Upper City Cantina]]. He warned Revan not to delay, having an awareness of the lack of patience common to many Mandalorians.

After delivering his message, the Twi'lek departed. He may have perished in the [[Destruction of Taris|bombing of Taris]] carried out under the orders of [[Darth Malak]].<ref name="KotOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You there &ndash; human. You are the rider who won the Great Swoop Race in the Lower City, yes?|translated=1|Unidentified Twi'lek messenger to Revan|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
This individual was a straightforward being who deferred to his employer, considering himself little more than "a runner." He recognized [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] on sight as the winner of the [[Tarisian Season Opener]], and was aware both of Ordo's connections to the [[Exchange]] and of the impatience of many [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], including his employer.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
This individual is referred to only as "Twi'lek" in ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'', and makes a single appearance outside the player's hideout following the [[rescue of Bastila Shan]], leading to the "Slicing Through Sith Security" quest. He shares the same character model and clothing as other green Twi'leks in the game, including [[Bib Surool]], [[Larrim]] and [[Karal Kaar]].<ref name="KotOR" />

His NPC file name is "tar02_rodianmsg" which suggests that he was originally intended to be a Rodian instead of a Twi'lek. His sound Set in the same file is also set to "Rodian" though it is unheard in-game as he is never turned hostile.
